anomalies.observed: The 'ATO Valve' driver uses T4 (BT3904) -> R10 -> gate of T5, which is an AO3400A (small-signal SOT-23 N-MOS) switching the ATO_VALVE load. parsed.summary: The build deviates from the intended design in two places: the TF-Luna LiDAR (PR1), which the spec documents as unwired/free, is in this schematic connected to the +5V rail and the main I2C bus via H1; and the ATO-valve switch is implemented with T5 (AO3400A) driven by R10/T4 instead of the intended T3 (AON6407), with T3 instead inserted as a series element in the 24V input that the spec's power tree omits.
